name: [🏦] YoYo Simulator 🪀
desc:
🪀 Welcome to YoYo Simulator!

How to Play:
🖱️ Click to swing your Yo-Yo
⚡ Upgrade Yo-Yos & DNAs to get stronger
🎖️ Rank up to unlock powerful multipliers!
🌎 Unlock new worlds
🥚 Buy eggs to hatch rare pets 🐾
🏆 Climb the leaderboards

😎 Premium Benefits: +10% Clicks! +25% Luck
🤗 Friend Benefits: Invite your Friends for an Extra 10% Egg Luck

💖 Enjoying the game? Leave a thumbs up! 👍
🔔 Follow the game to be the first to know when updates drop! 🎯
